footer.title: Disclaimer
footer.intro: This page is a summary for your convenience. It is not the official terms of any offer.
points: Instant savings are taken off at checkout. Each rebate is paid after you send a claim, by the manufacturer or the rebate program named on the offer.
The official terms decide each offer. If this page and the official terms are different, the official terms apply.
The manufacturer or the rebate program can change or end an offer at any time without notice.
The rebate processor named on each offer approves or rejects each rebate claim. AA Kitchen does not make this decision.
You are responsible for sending your claim correctly and before the deadline.
AA Kitchen is not responsible for errors or missing information on this page, or for a rebate that is rejected, late, or not paid.
footer.closing: Please check the official terms of each offer, or ask our team, before you buy.
